corporate_action_audit.annotations: RETROSPECTIVE_OUTCOME_QUALITY_ONLY; no signal changes or dividend adjustment factors

definitions.atr: original signal features.atr14 only; missing/nonpositive gives PARTIAL with raw path retained
definitions.clusters: per-security connected components of closed signal-to-longest-requested-endpoint intervals, including unavailable paths; cross-strategy bridges retained
definitions.corporate_actions: retrospective PR6 annotations; known effects and sourced bounds separate from global unknown ex-dates; sensitivity excludes known/bounded overlaps
definitions.dispersion: population standard deviation of available observations; descriptive, no independent-sample inference
definitions.excursions: nonnegative favorable/adverse price magnitudes divided by reference for percent; by original signal ATR14 for ATR units
definitions.execution: NONE; no costs, borrow, stop sequence, PnL or realized R
definitions.path: all expected reference-through-end sessions required; no compression or forward fill
definitions.reference_close: signal Close; endpoint t+h; excursions t+1 through t+h
definitions.reference_open: first expected RTH Open strictly after signal availability; endpoint reference+h; excursions reference through endpoint
definitions.returns: 100*(endpoint Close/reference-1); SHORT normalized by sign inversion, not short-sale return

dependence.interpretation: Closed-window connected components per security, across strategies; clusters may still share market/time dependence
